cardOverview.overviewText: A Kotak Biz card crafted for SMEs and entrepreneurs, offering cashback on business-related spends, milestone vouchers, and expense tracking tools.

benefitRows.name: Insurance
benefitRows.offer: Card Liability Cover (Lost Card Liability, Counterfeit/Skimming/Phishing, and Online Fraud Protection) upto 50,000.
benefitRows.howToAvail: If your card is lost, stolen, or used fraudulently, report it immediately by calling Kotak Bank's 24/7 helpline at 1860 266 2666

benefitRows.name: Insurance
benefitRows.howToAvail: For insurance claims, contact Zurich Kotak General Insurance at 1800 266 4545 or email care@zurichkotak.com
